turns.text: How is your pronunciation and how is your fluency?
turns.zh: 你的发音怎么样，流利度怎么样？

turns.text: Maybe you want to give yourself a little score and pop it into the comments below.
turns.zh: 也许你想给自己打个分，然后发到下面的评论区里。

turns.text: If you found that difficult or if you think you need additional help, you may want to check out www.E2Language.com we've got an amazing online IELTS preparation course.
turns.zh: 如果你觉得这很难，或者你觉得你需要额外的帮助，你可能想看看 www.E2Language.com，我们有一个很棒的在线雅思备考课程。

turns.text: And what you can do as part of that course is actually book one on one speaking tutorials with expert IELTS teachers, including some of them who are ex-IELTS examiners so they know exactly what happens and what you need to do.
turns.zh: 作为那个课程的一部分，你可以做的是实际上预约一对一口语辅导，和专业的雅思老师，包括其中一些是前雅思考官，所以他们确切知道会发生什么以及你需要做什么。

turns.text: Well, today since you don't have a teacher with you, you can listen back to your recording.
turns.zh: 嗯，今天既然你身边没有老师，你可以回听你的录音。
